gate.name: stage2_grpo_rollout_identity_fix
gate.scope: root-cause correction, focused regression, and isolated two-update GPU smoke

failure.exception: models.bev_planner.joint_grpo.JointGRPOError: each joint rollout may be updated exactly once
failure.root_cause: The trainer retained bare id(rollout) integers forever. After a completed rollout was released, Python could reuse that object address for a fresh rollout, causing a false duplicate-update rejection.

implementation.change: Replace the permanent set of integer object addresses with a WeakValueDictionary keyed by object address and validate identity against the live weak value.
